_description: Device specifications for adding realistic device frames around screenshots

iphone_17_pro_max_portrait.bezel_path: ../assets/bezels/iPhone 17 Pro Max/iPhone 17 Pro Max - Silver - Portrait.png

_notes: Device keys must match normalized device names from step 1
bezel_path specifies relative path from config directory to device bezel PNG file
Bezel files are organized by device in assets/bezels/ with color variants (Silver, Deep Blue, etc.)
corner_radius determines rounded corners for device bezels
app_store_size must match Apple's requirements for App Store Connect
